verdict.rationale: Superset provides building blocks rather than a triage feature. The SDK can 'script the creation, triage, or cleanup of tasks', and scheduled automations or the MCP server can run agents that manage tasks, so a user could assemble an issue-triage agent. A community note also mentions a paid Linear integration. However, nothing documents built-in automatic triage, severity suggestion, or owner routing. Missing for 10: native automatic triage of incoming issues, severity suggestion, routing or assignment to owners, documented issue-tracker ingestion flow, hands-on corroboration.
